messages:
Alex: heads up — we're seeing ~4-6% of requests for tenant-prod hitting the legacy model variant even when X-Model-Version header is present. started ~09:12 UTC.
Maria: whoa, any recent rollout for ingress rules?
Alex: nope, no rollout. looks like a route-match regression in the gateway rule precedence. matching order changed for the headerless branch.
Jun (oncall): pinging infra, putting this as P1. can we narrow blast radius to affected tenants?
Kat: quick check — telemetry shows requests with header `X-Model-Version: v2` but route decision goes to `model_variant: v1`. logs show path /v1/generate selected.
sre-bot: deploy detected: gateway-config v2026.03.18-7 pushed 08:58 UTC to edge.
Maria: that aligns. config diff shows this block was re-ordered:
```yaml
- match: header_exists(X-Model-Version)
  route: prefer-v2
- match: path_prefix /
  route: prefer-v1
```
became
```yaml
- match: path_prefix /
  route: prefer-v1
- match: header_exists(X-Model-Version)
  route: prefer-v2
```
Alex: exact issue — path_prefix now wins before header check for shorter sequences. bad reordering.
Jun (oncall): options: 1) revert gateway-config to previous commit (safe), 2) hotpatch rule to add explicit higher-priority header match via `priority: 100`, 3) route pin for affected tenant ids.
Kat: revert is fastest. can we rollback to v2026.03.18-6?
Maria: revert requires CI + canary; but deploy pipeline can do an emergency rollback w/ no schema change. timeline ~6-8 min.
Alex: for immediate mitigation, we can also push a short-lived header-match shim using the dynamic route API: POST /internal/routes/hotpatch with body:
```json
{"priority":100,"match":{"headers":{"X-Model-Version":{"present":true}}},"route":"prefer-v2-hotfix"}
```
Jun (oncall): I can do the hotpatch now, confirm permissions. if hotpatch succeeds, we still do full revert for clean history.
Kat: rolled hotpatch command to staging first — staging shows correct match order.
sre-bot: audit: route-hotpatch created by Jun at 09:34:22 UTC (id rtp-5782).
Jun (oncall): pushing hotpatch to prod now.
Alex: telemetry starting to show drop in misrouted requests 09:35:10 UTC. good signal.
Maria: still want full revert to previous config to avoid relying on transient hotpatch. creating revert PR now.
Alex: can we coordinate a short canary after revert? put 5% to master rule for 10m.
Maria: yup — PR includes canary config. asking infra to approve expedited rollback CI job.
Kat: double-checking dashboards — make sure latency dashboards include variant breakdown, to catch any perf regressions post-revert. added a temporary alert if v1 requests >1% for tenants flagged.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion: if rollback fails, execute tenant pin via BGP header injection (ops playbook 3.2), notify customers with ETA 15m.
Jun (oncall): revert PR merged 09:42 UTC, deploy started. canary 5% for 10m. monitoring closely.
Alex: after canary succeeded (09:53) we promoted full rollout. misrouted rate back to baseline ~0.02%.
Maria: follow-ups: 1) add unit test for route precedence to gateway repo, 2) include header-existence case in CI contract tests, 3) postmortem doc.
Kat: created a tiny dashboard tile for "route-match mismatches" + linked to traces.
Jun (oncall): closing incident channel. thanks all — good triage. :thumbsup:
Alex: notes for postmortem: avoid reordering match blocks in single commit without explicit precedence metadata. suggest adding `priority` required field to rule schema.
Maria: I'll draft postmortem and link change-commit + hotpatch audit.
Kat: leaving a tip in the console: when editing gateway rules, show a warning if moving path-based rules above header-based rules.
Jun (oncall): final: no customer impact beyond a tiny % of requests; SLA intact. marking as resolved.
